Method of Attack: Authenticated user with subscriber-level and above permissions can update and modify posts with malicious content
Attackers can forge a request on behalf of a site’s administrator to modify plugin settings allowing malicious JavaScript injection
Unprotected AJAX actions, nonce disclosure, lack of Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection
Exploitation of site users' browsers to compromise their computers
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using vulnerable versions of PageLayer plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in PageLayer WordPress plugin via authenticated user actions and forged administrator requests
Indicators of Compromise: Sites running PageLayer versions older than 1.1.2
